claims.text: Evening primrose oil (GLA): evidence limited; a monitored 3–6 mo trial may be considered as supportive Tx in refractory cases
claims.quote: Nutritional supplements, including gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) derived from evening primrose oil, have been proposed to reduce luteal-phase breast pain; although evidence of efficacy remains limited, a monitored trial of 3 to 6 months may be considered as supportive therapy in refractory cases.

claims.text: Use as an adjunct for breast pain, ⍉monotx
claims.quote: say it can be adj in pain management, not as monotx for pain
